routed.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.age_group = 'Under 18' THEN d.offender_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(d.offender_count), 1) AS youth_share_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN d.age_group = 'Under 18' THEN d.offender_count ELSE 0 END) AS youth_count, SUM(d.offender_count) AS total_count FROM rollup.state_summary_offender_demographics d WHERE d.state = 'CA' AND d.ucr_offense_code IN ('09A','11A','11B','11C','120','13A') AND d.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
